candidates.name: Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis
support_spans: 23 glomeruli examined: 6 globally sclerotic, 10 segmentally sclerotic, cellular, and filling Bowman's space circumferentially
candidates.why: The patient's renal biopsy shows segmental sclerosis and glomerular damage

candidates.name: Chronic tubulointerstitial nephritis
support_spans: 80% of the cortex and outer medulla had chronic tubulointerstitial damage
candidates.why: The patient's renal biopsy shows chronic tubulointerstitial damage

candidates.name: Post-infectious glomerulonephritis
support_spans: Blood cultures: positive for Corynebacterium jeikeium
candidates.why: The patient's blood culture is positive for Corynebacterium jeikeium, which may indicate a post-infectious mechanism

candidates.name: ANCA-associated vasculitis
support_spans: Elevated PR3-ANCA and rheumatoid factor concentrations
candidates.why: The patient's laboratory tests show elevated PR3-ANCA, which is associated with ANCA-associated vasculitis

candidates.name: Infective endocarditis
support_spans: Multiple foci of increased metabolic activity at the LVAD driveline insertion site, the ventricular assist device pocket, and the LVAD outflow cannula
candidates.why: The patient's 18F-FDG PET-CT shows increased metabolic activity at the LVAD site, which may indicate infective endocarditis

candidates.name: Membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis

candidates.why: The patient's renal biopsy shows positive mesangial staining for IgM, C1q, and C3, which is consistent with membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis
